title: Bit 7 / bit 5 parity validation
description: Validate bit 7 and bit 5 parity per spec
notes: 2026-08-25 S/SI parity blocker: Python frame tests pass (135 passed, 10 skipped) and Rust frame tests pass (16), including canonical bytes for every mode, S/SI together on signed frames, neither on unsigned, S-only/SI-only rejection, reserved MIC selector rejection, encryption precedence, truncation, and signed max payload. Read-only C matrix using current lichen_frame_parse/write: neither/0x00 accepts+roundtrips (correct); S-only/0x20 accepts+roundtrips (incorrect); SI-only/0x80 rejects -EINVAL; canonical S+SI/0xA0 rejects -EINVAL (incorrect). Root cause: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/frame.c:19/76-85 declares bit 7 reserved rather than SI and frame.c:139-142/183-190 forbids signer/never sets SI. C TX also emits S-only at lichen_link_tx.c:117 and :257. Existing C ctest passes because its signed positives deliberately use stale 0x20/0x21 bytes. C is read-only this phase, so this bead cannot close until C makes bit7=SI, requires exact S==SI parity, parses/writes 8 signer bytes when set, emits 0xA0|mode from TX, and consumes the canonical malformed/vector cases.
